d: Vita port of the syncthing utility
ld: states, screenshots and music travel between your Vita, your computer, your Steam Deck or your phone, over your home Wi-Fi or across the Internet, with no cloud account and no USB cable.
req:
- You need a PS Vita (or PS TV) running homebrew (HENkaku / Ensō), with Enable Unsafe
- Homebrew turned on in HENkaku Settings: the app needs full homebrew permissions to read
